verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since a game/rendering engine can plausibly offer event-driven action rules. The evidence only glancingly supports it: the scene graph lists 'actions' (docs-38), and scene interaction is said to use behaviors, ray casting and mesh picking (docs-41). Neither item documents how rules are defined or how triggers map to actions. Missing for 10: documentation of an event-trigger/action rule system (trigger types, conditions, chained actions), any no-code or declarative rule authoring, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
